lines: You hide behind a filing cabinet.
Ardis's voice echoes in the basement.
"I know you're down here. It's over."

w1.text: There's a secret exit behind the north wall.

w2.text: But it's locked with an old numerical keypad. It requires the date of the town's founding.

g1.text: Find the founding year in the inspection report photo.

mg1.title: Founding Year

config.brief: Spot the founding date stamped on the document.

hints: Look at the top left corner of the report for the year '1892'.

lines: You punch it into the keypad. The wall slides open.
You slip into the darkness just as Ardis turns the corner.

m1.text: That was close. But you're not safe yet.

m2.text: You are now in the old maintenance tunnels. They lead straight to the dam.
